text_block_list.text: Today marks the final day of the training camp with Maruzensky—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Youth really is fleeting, isn't it?
To think the summer training camp is already over...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Still, this is no time to get sentimental. The Arima Kinen will be here in the blink of an eye."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To make this the best race possible,
let's put everything we gained from training camp to good use!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, where are you off to,
Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: I was thinking of taking the bus...
